name: ship-weather
description: Fleet health as weather in Wheelhouse’s header, from clear to stormy; click it for what’s wrong, why, and the latest events.

headroomLow.title: Claude headroom is low at (% left)
headroomLow.description: Below this much of the session or week left, the weather clouds over.

headroomCritical.title: Claude headroom is nearly out at (% left)
headroomCritical.description: Below this much of the session or week left, it’s a storm.

stormAt.title: Storm when this many things are failing
stormAt.description: Failing checks, failed steps or tasks, and workers not answering, counted together.

decisionsForCloud.title: Cloud over when this many decisions wait on you
decisionsForCloud.description: Fewer than this is still fair weather.

githubChecks.title: Read pull request checks from GitHub
githubChecks.description: Asks GitHub (with gh) for the failing checks on up to eight open pull requests at each read.

events.title: Latest events to keep
events.description: How many events the ship’s log holds; it shows the newest four until you ask for more.
